# Is your delivery route worth driving? True profit per route, per hour and per stop

> Free calculator for independent delivery van contractors. Enter route pay, stops, packages, miles, fuel, van payment, insurance and tax set-aside; it shows true profit per route, per hour and per stop, break-even stops, the lowest route pay that hits your hourly target, and compares two route offers.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
